ei.title: 진정한 성공: 타인의 복사본이 아닌 나 자신이 되는 것

fullPassage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not arise from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is successful in you and following your own path.

questions.passage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not (A)[depend / insist] on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not arise from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a (B)[poor / excellent] copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is (C)[successful / inferior] in you and following your own path.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② depend — poor — successful: 성공은 모방에 달려 있지 않고, 모방은 형편없는 복사이며, 자신 안에서 성공적인 것을 찾아야 한다
❌ ① insist(주장하다)는 on과 결합하지만 '~에 달려 있다'와 의미 다름
❌ ③ excellent(훌륭한)는 copy를 긍정하여 모방 비판과 모순
❌ ④ inferior(열등한)는 '성공적인'의 반의어로 맥락상 부적절

questions.passage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not (A)[arise / vanish] from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the real thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no (B)[substance / beauty] in a forgery. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a (C)[pretense / reality]. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from finding that which is successful in you and following your own path.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① arise — substance — pretense: 성공은 남의 길에서 발생하지 않고, 위조에는 실체가 없으며, 그것은 가식일 뿐이다
❌ ② vanish(사라지다)는 arise의 반의어로 문맥에 부적합
❌ ③ beauty(아름다움)는 위조의 본질 문제와 무관
❌ ④ reality(현실)는 pretense(가식)의 반의어로 부적절

questions.passage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not arise from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only imitate them. But an imitation is just a poor copy, it is never the (A)[real / ideal] thing; it is fool's gold. The reflection in the mirror can never be the person standing before the mirror, no matter how much they look alike. There is no substance in a (B)[forgery / masterpiece]. Everyone knows it isn't the real thing. Everyone knows it's just a pretense. So your success must come from being the real thing, the real you. It must come from (C)[finding / losing] that which is successful in you and following your own path.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ real — forgery — finding: 모방은 진짜가 아니고, 위조에는 실체가 없으며, 자신 안의 성공을 '찾아야' 한다
❌ ① ideal(이상적인)은 '진짜'와 다른 의미로 never the __ thing 맥락에 부적합
❌ ② masterpiece(걸작)는 '실체가 없다'는 부정 맥락과 모순
❌ ③ losing(잃는 것)은 finding의 반의어로 자기 발견 맥락에 부적절

questions.passage: Failure comes through you, not to you, because success does not depend on imitating the success of others. Failure does. Success does not ①<u>arise</u> from following in the path of someone else. Failure does. Why? Because you cannot be them, no matter how hard you try. At best, you can only ②<u>imitate</u> them. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

✅ ① arise: 발생하다 — 적절
✅ ② imitate: 모방하다 — 적절
❌ ③ avoiding: 원문 finding의 반의어. 자신 안의 성공적인 것을 '찾아야' 하므로 avoiding(피하기)은 부적절
✅ ④ following: 자신의 길을 따르다 — 적절

❌ ④ unsuccessful: 원문 successful의 반의어. 자신 안의 '성공적인' 것을 찾아야 하므로 unsuccessful은 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 through의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) ~을 통해서 — (B) ~을 지나서: (A)는 실패가 자신을 '통해' 오는 추상적 경유, (B)는 문을 '지나' 들어오는 물리적 이동
❌ ① (A)는 '~에도 불구하고'가 아님
❌ ② 의미 뒤바뀜
❌ ④ (B)는 '~때문에'가 아님
det.tip: through: ① ~을 통해(경유/원인) ② ~을 지나서(물리적 통과)
